rows.Origin: Bred by Francois Dorieux II (1955-2015) (France, before 1987).
rows.Bloom: Red, white undertones, apricot shading. (Rouge clair nuance blanc et apricot). Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long buds.
